title: Wells
summary: Wells were vital meeting places and sources of life for households, travelers, shepherds, and flocks.
background: Biblical well scenes often involve provision, covenant, marriage arrangements, conflict, or divine appointment.
teachingHelp: When a passage occurs at a well, look for God’s provision and the social significance of meeting at a life-sustaining place.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
